description: Open a vault part by opaque part_id and/or assembly_id into the current assembly (reference). No path or name lookup. Does not write git. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

assembly_id.description: Assembly surf-id whose parts are opened by reference.

part_id.description: Part surf-id to open by reference into the current assembly.

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: open_part
